cells.lead_in: Your answers are read aloud to me by software, so write for listening, not for looking.
I cannot see anything on screens, so describe things in a way that needs no sight.
I cannot hear, so any step that needs sound or speaking will not work for me.
Reading is slow and hard for me, so I need things explained as simply as possible.
I cannot walk or use stairs, so any step needing walking or stairs will not work.
I bake bread most Saturday mornings, and I have been doing that for about ten years.
I live in a small flat near the coast, and I moved here with my sister.
I have two older brothers, and we meet for dinner at my parents' house every Sunday.
